text_block_list.text:
One day, as we're walking through the
shopping
district on the way home...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Geez, that's loud...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
I received a raffle ticket earlier when I
bought
something, which is perfect
because...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: We gotta give this a try, Taishin!

text_block_list.text:
Why don't you just do it yourself? I'm
gonna head
home.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Those things are always rigged so you
don't
actually win anything.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
That grand prize is nothing but a pipe
dream.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Oho! I see you've got your eyes on the
grand
prize, miss! That's the spirit!
Dream big or go
home!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: Huh?! I wasn't even—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Ugh! Shut your piehole, dummy!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин spins the lever of the
raffle
machine with a somewhat
puckered expression.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh? Seriously?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I actually won the hot spring trip?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Oh, uh, thanks...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин is so surprised that all she
can
manage is a genuine show of
gratitude.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Here. This belongs to you since it was
your raffle
ticket.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
But you're the one who won the prize. You
should get to enjoy it.

text_block_list.text: Fine.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's why you're asking which of
us would
like to join you on a trip.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Oooh, wow! A trip to a hot spring? I'd love to—
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Now, hold on, Ticket.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Bwah?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
You really need to be more sensitive to
your friends'
feelings.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Taishin. The two of us will
be busy
for the foreseeable future, so
I'm afraid we can't
go with you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There's much to do after the Twinkle
Series as
well.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm sure there's someone who
would
make a far more fitting travel
companion.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
A what now? Who are you even talking
about?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Which would be more embarrassing for
you?
Having everyone spell it out or
having to figure it
out yourself?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Nnngh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I hate it when you do that, Hayahide.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, do you? I love how awkward you
are,
though.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Later, Нарита Таисин barges into my
office, rushes
up to me, and shoves the
vacation ticket into my
hands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Shelve this.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
If I can't find anyone to go with me by
the
expiration date, then...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Then nothing! Anyway!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Just shelve it for now!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Geez, it's enormous...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Right?! It's big enough to satisfy even
the
hungriest Umamusume! And I know
how much you
guys like to eat!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: (This is way too much for me...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Oh, I know.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
That night, while I'm working in my
office...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Good, you're here. You have dinner yet?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Yeah? You better not tell me you don't
like
Bolognese.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Pre-cooked hamburger steaks are just
ground
meat once you smash them up...
So, yeah.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
You made this with that carrot hamburger
steak?!

text_block_list.text: Yeah. Is that a crime?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The raffle ticket was yours, so you
should have a
share of this too.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, hurry up and eat before it goes
cold.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't bring myself to cut the
hamburger
steak in half and share it all
chummy-like, but
this... This, I can do.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, that's an insane amount of
carrots.
What the hell am I supposed to
do with all these?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I guess there's only one thing I can
do.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Whoooaaa! I've never seen so many
carrots!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I can understand how it would've been a
struggle
for you two to finish this alone.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Are we really allowed to take
as much
as we want?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but don't come crying to me if you
eat too
many and get sick.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Woohoo! It's carrot party tiiiime!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Of course you aren't listening...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
In any case, I'll happily take some as
well.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
This is actually a lifesaver. I was having
trouble
thinking of side dishes to include
in Brian's lunch.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I only won them because I used my
trainer's raffle
ticket, so don't thank me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
But you were the one who suggested that we
share them, Taishin.

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Taishin! I always knew you were super nice at heart!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ughhh, stop that! I'm not nice at all!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: You looking to get punted into the sun?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won third
prize!
Here's your carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You heard 'em. Here.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Нарита Таисин tosses the carrot at me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That came from your raffle ticket, so it's
yours.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it's almost time for dinner, so
let's go
home and—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Grumble...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Can it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Not even! I'm not hungry, and I don't
want the
carrot!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Gruuumble!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Urrrgh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Tissues...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
It's not like I care. It was your raffle
ticket.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Besides, it's not like we can't go to a hot spring without winning some ticket at a raffle.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You being all sorry for me is what's
making this
awkward.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's go home. You can have
the tissues.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин rushes off, but her
expression is
tinged with frustration as
she brushes past me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And that's how I end up holding onto
the ticket
for the hot spring vacation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Together, we eat the special Bolognese
pasta
that Taishin made, and it's
absolutely delicious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I offer the carrot to Нарита Таисин again,
and she
snatches it from me without a
word.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With our lucky raffle prize, we hold a
delightful
carrot party together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
